title: Fix unchecked atomic_write exits in test plugin and intake
goal: Ensure a failed result write in the test stage or intake never leaves a prior round's data looking current, and add a lint rule that catches future unchecked | atomic_write calls.

steps.description: Write failing tests for R1 in `tests/unit/test-plugin-result-write-fallback-test.sh` and `tests/unit/test-result-reason-contract-test.sh`: simulate `atomic_write` succeeding on jq output but failing at the write layer while a prior round's result file is present; assert the result is either absent or `broken` with reason `result_write_failed` and that the live reader (`runner_read_stage_verdict`) classifies it as `broken`, never as the prior round's outcome.

Fix `_test_write_result` in `plugins/tool/test/plugin.sh`: capture the full PIPESTATUS array after `jq … | atomic_write`; treat a non-zero write exit (index 1) the same as a non-zero jq exit (index 0), so a failed write triggers the broken fallback even when jq succeeded.

Write failing tests for R2 in `plugins/agent/intake/tests/intake-result-test.sh`: simulate `atomic_write` failing for `scope-manifest.md` and for `intake.md` in turn; assert intake exits non-zero in each case and that the reason names the failing file.

Fix `_intake_run_inner` in `plugins/agent/intake/plugin.sh`: check the exit status of both `atomic_write` calls (`scope-manifest.md` and `intake.md`); on write failure, call `_intake_write_result` with outcome `broken` and a reason that names the file, then return non-zero.

Write failing tests for R3 in `tests/unit/plugin-primary-output-atomic-test.sh`: invoke the lint script against a synthetic fixture with an unchecked `| atomic_write` and assert it exits non-zero naming the line; assert it exits 0 on a checked fixture; and assert it exits 0 when run against the real codebase (this last assertion fails until step-7 applies the annotations).

Add `scripts/lib/lint-atomic-write-unchecked.sh`: scan every `.sh` file under `core/`, `plugins/`, and `scripts/` for `| atomic_write` whose exit status is not checked on the same or immediately following line via `&&`, `||`, `if !`, or a PIPESTATUS index capturing the write; fail with a file-and-line message for each violation.

Annotate the 13 pre-existing safe `| atomic_write` calls in 9 files (`core/detect/platforms.sh`, `core/pipeline/state_helpers.sh`, `core/output/destinations.sh`, `plugins/agent/pr-delivery/plugin.sh`, `plugins/tool/merge/plugin.sh`, `plugins/tool/output-github-comment/plugin.sh`, `plugins/tool/pr-open/plugin.sh`, `plugins/tool/test/lib/acceptance-reason.sh`, `plugins/tool/test/lib/acceptance-check.sh`) with `|| true` so the lint passes on the full codebase without treating best-effort diagnostic writes as errors.
Wire the new lint script into `npm run lint` in `package.json` by appending `&& bash scripts/lib/lint-atomic-write-unchecked.sh` to the lint target, so R3 runs on every `npm run lint` invocation.
